name: AI agents barely order anything
ig:
AI agents promise to order for you. So how many people actually use them?
In Halloween week only four Uber rides were booked through an agent. Would you let AI order for you?
#אבאאיציק #AI #AIagents
Source: Uber and DoorDash reports, 2026
